notes:
- Added a real crash-safety net: uncaught errors and unhandled promise rejections no longer silently kill the app or freeze the UI with zero indication anything went wrong
- Fixed two backend routes that leaked a raw error page (with server file paths) on malformed input instead of a clean error message
- Verified against the actual packaged app, not just source, after fuzz-testing every API route
- Also includes 1.0.1's fixes: open CORS + unrestricted local file read, shell command injection in the open-folder action, crash-causing missing error handlers, a Whisper transcription hang, a TTS timeout, and hardware encoder detection that was breaking renders on non-NVIDIA machines
